description: ThoughtFox shared Renovate preset — public mirror. Source of truth is thoughtfox-ai/FoxKit packages/tooling/config/renovate/default.json (private); this file is copied here, verbatim apart from this description, so repos outside the thoughtfox-ai org can extend it. Extend with github>thoughtfox-ai/renovate-config. Do not edit this file directly — edit FoxKit's copy and re-sync.

packageRules.description: Automerge every update that should not break anything (patch, minor, digest and pin updates, and the weekly lock-file refresh), but ONLY once every status check on the PR is green (Niki, 2026-09-27: 'whatever is safe auto-merges on green'). platformAutomerge is off on purpose: Renovate then merges the PR itself, only when the branch is up to date and every check passed, and never in a repo with no checks at all (ignoreTests stays false). GitHub's native auto-merge would merge immediately in a repo whose branch protection doesn't require checks.
Below 1.0.0, semver lets a package break things in any patch or minor release, so 0.x third-party updates wait for a human (Renovate's own documented safeguard).

Exception to the 0.x rule for FoxKit's own packages: FoxKit's changesets use patch = fix, minor = addition, major = breaking even before 1.0 (FoxKit CLAUDE.md rule 6), so their patch and minor releases are safe to automerge. Security-sensitive FoxKit packages are switched back off by the LAST rule.

Framework minors (Next.js, React, Tailwind) wait for a human: they can change runtime behaviour that a green build doesn't catch (StratOps's 2026-07-06 outage passed the build). Framework patches still automerge.
Major updates never automerge: they are breaking by definition.
Framework majors wait 14 days after release (plan §4.8 gate 1).

Hold TypeScript below 7 (2026-09-29, FoxKit #19). TypeScript 7 is the native (Go) rewrite and ships no JavaScript compiler API (its main entry only exports the version), so typescript-eslint, which @thoughtfox-ai/config's ESLint setup runs in every app, crashes on load (typescript-eslint 8.71.0 declares typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0). Next.js 16.3's own type-check does work on 7. Revisit when typescript-eslint (and Next.js) support TS 7; then remove this rule in a @thoughtfox-ai/config release.

Radix UI primitives move together: mismatched @radix-ui/* versions inside one app are a common source of subtle breakage, and FoxKit's own @thoughtfox-ai/ui uses the unified radix-ui package. Found repeated across StratOps, FlowFox, FamilyOps, elevAIte and others (2026-09-27 scan).
dnd-kit's core/sortable/utilities packages are versioned as one unit; update together to avoid drag-and-drop breaking silently. Found in FamilyOps, StratOps, elevAIte, FlowFox (2026-09-27 scan).
BlockNote's core/react/mantine packages must match versions or the editor breaks. Found in FamilyOps, StratOps, FlowFox (2026-09-27 scan).

TanStack and Zustand: the shared app-level data and state layer, grouped to cut PR noise (they don't have to move together, but repos almost always bump them at the same time). Found in FamilyOps, StratOps, FlowFox, elevAIte (2026-09-27 scan).

Supabase client packages, grouped so ssr and supabase-js stay compatible. Found in nearly every app (2026-09-27 scan). Note: this is the raw @supabase/* npm packages, not FoxKit's own future @thoughtfox-ai/database package (that one is in the security-sensitive rule below).
Test tooling, grouped to cut PR noise; low risk since it never ships to users. Found in most apps (2026-09-27 scan).
Forms and validation move together: react-hook-form's resolvers are versioned against specific zod ranges. Found in nearly every app (2026-09-27 scan).
The rest of the shadcn/ui utility belt that isn't Radix itself, grouped to cut PR noise. Found across StratOps, FlowFox, FamilyOps, elevAIte and others (2026-09-27 scan).

One PR per repo for every safe non-major update (Niki, 2026-09-27: 'group different upgrades into a single PR and auto-merge on green ... otherwise there will be too many PRs'). Renovate's own group:allNonMajor pattern. It overrides the ecosystem groups above for patch/minor/digest/pin updates, so those groups now only batch majors. Only updates that automerge may land here: a grouped PR merges only when every member may, so the rules below move everything that waits for a human (0.x third-party, framework, security-sensitive FoxKit) into their own groups.

0.x third-party patch/minor updates wait for a human (rule 2), so they get their own review PR instead of holding back the auto-merging all-non-major PR. FoxKit's own 0.x packages are moved back out by the FoxKit group below.

Framework group: Next.js, React and Tailwind move together in one PR per app, never half an upgrade (plan §4.8 gate 3). Placed after the all-non-major group so framework updates (whose minors wait for a human) never hold that PR back; a framework PR with only patches still automerges.

FoxKit packages: grouped, so one FoxKit release is one PR per app, arriving without the 3-day wait or the Monday schedule. Placed after the all-non-major and 0.x groups so FoxKit updates always land here.
Majors of anything get a clear label.

Security-sensitive FoxKit packages get their own PR, are NEVER automerged at any update level, and always need a human review (plan §4.6 stricter rules). Keep this rule LAST among the automerge rules so nothing re-enables automerge.
